Visit note | 2025-10-19 04:30 PM | Dr. Nazma Begum, Obstetrics and Gynecology | Patient: Rabeya Bepari, 31, female. Mrs. Bepari comes in for review regarding acne, extra facial hair growth, and gradual weight gain. She mentions she noticed this weight gain after starting a sedentary desk job in Savar. She works as a madrasa teacher and her current symptoms have been ongoing for several months with irregular cycles. She has no chronic comorbidities. On examination: BMI 31.5, BP 114/73 mmHg, pulse 89 bpm, weight 73 kg. There is mild hirsutism on the chin, and pelvic examination is unremarkable. Assessment: Polycystic ovary syndrome. Plan: a prescription was issued for her ongoing management. She was advised to aim for a 5% weight loss, engage in 150 minutes of exercise a week, and cut down on sugary drinks. Follow-up in 3 months.
